filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Tue Oct 13 – Wed Oct 14 PT

market_briefing.lede: Quotes, contracts and deal rooms are becoming tools the assistant calls, not tabs reps open. In the last two days Conga and GetAccept shipped MCP servers for Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot, and Aligned put an agent inside the deal room that edits the deal itself, with the rep approving each change.

bullets.text: Contracts and quotes over MCP: Conga's MCP Server (Oct 14) connects Claude, Copilot and other MCP clients to live contract, quote and obligation data; Conga CLM and Conga Contracts for Salesforce now support Salesforce MCP to create, negotiate, sign and manage contracts in natural language inside Salesforce.

Deal rooms from the chat window: GetAccept MCP (Oct 13) lets Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini read room engagement, log calls, update mutual action plans and build/publish a Digital Sales Room; reminders and invites ask before sending.

Agents that act inside the deal: Aligned's Seller Agent (beta, Oct 14) rewrites content, updates mutual action plans and builds decks and calculators in the deal workspace; every change is source-linked and applied only with rep approval; pricing after beta.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Argon
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 13: frontier model GA via Gemini API, Gemini app (Pro/Ultra), AI Mode and Antigravity; Google claims #1 on the Vals Index; intro price $2/$10 per million input/output tokens through Nov 30, then $4/$20; 1M-token limit.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI CFO: a more capable model is being held back
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 14: Sarah Friar told the Dublin AI summit OpenAI is withholding an internal model (which she said proved the Navier-Stokes equations) pending more safety work. OpenAI's own claim; not independently verified.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI retires GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 from the API on Jan 14, 2027
biggest_ai_news.body: Notice Oct 14: GPT-4o, 4o mini, 4.1 and 4.1 mini snapshots (and their fine-tunes) shut down; recommended replacement gpt-6-luna.

biggest_ai_news.title: NVIDIA gives $250M in compute to UK AI-safety research
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 14: five-year pledge for agentic safety and security research; UK confirmed its AI Security Institute tests frontier models before release.

what_changed.title: Conga ships MCP Server, AiMe expansion and Salesforce MCP tools for CLM
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent, Salesforce ecosystem). Oct 14 at Conga Connection: MCP Server for Claude and Copilot over live contracts, quotes and obligations; AiMe with 90+ tools and 19 skills; new CLM AI (Redline, Search, Compliance Screening, Clause Library Builder, Tools for Salesforce MCP); GC AI and SAP Ariba integrations. Why it matters: quote-to-contract becomes a callable layer for whichever assistant or CRM agent the rep uses.

what_changed.title: GetAccept launches GetAccept MCP for deal rooms
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 13: Ask / Act / Build across deal rooms, contracts and calls from Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini; asks before sending reminders and invites; GetAccept Agent in Salesforce in beta for selected customers.

what_changed.title: Aligned releases Seller Agent inside the deal workspace
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 14: consult, execute, automate and create inside the deal room, powered by the always-on Aligned Brain; changes proposed then applied with rep approval; MCP client integration for extra data; beta on all plans, pricing after beta.

what_changed.title: Revenue Growth Agent launches MCP Connector for ChatGPT and Claude
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 14: Meeting Prepper, Discovery Conversion (MEDDIC gap analysis) and Solution Proposal agents run inside the assistant and can push updates to CRM records.

what_changed.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon generally available
what_changed.body: NEW (AI model). Oct 13: API, Gemini app, AI Mode and Antigravity; $2/$10 per million tokens introductory through Nov 30.

watch.title: Salesforce's October GAs: Agent Optimizer and AI Skills
watch.body: Mid-October and still no public GA flag or pricing for Agent Optimizer (beta through account executives since Sep 21) or AI Skills in Agentforce Coworker (pilot), both promised for October '26; Hunter stays in pilot until November. Partners are already wiring into Salesforce MCP (Conga, Oct 14). Watch release notes and the newsroom for status and Flex Credit pricing before month-end.

interpretation.fact: Conga announced its MCP Server, AiMe expansion and Salesforce MCP tools for CLM (Oct 14). GetAccept launched GetAccept MCP (Oct 13). Aligned released Seller Agent in beta (Oct 14). Revenue Growth Agent launched an MCP Connector (Oct 14). Google made Gemini 4 Argon GA (Oct 13). OpenAI's CFO said a more capable model is being withheld (Oct 14). OpenAI announced GPT-4o/4.1 API retirement for Jan 14, 2027 (Oct 14). NVIDIA pledged $250M of compute to UK AI-safety research (Oct 14).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: after content and CRM-hygiene connectors, deal execution (quotes, contracts, deal rooms) is the next layer going MCP, with confirm-before-write controls up front. Conga building to Salesforce MCP suggests partners are targeting Salesforce's MCP surface ahead of the Agent Optimizer / AI Skills GAs.
